This cluster is different. These objections do not try to escape the structure; they grant it and ask whether it is rich enough. Can mere structure accommodate conscious experience, intrinsic nature beneath relations, or the uncanny fit between mathematics and the world?

Because these challenges come from inside the picture, they cannot be met by the earlier reply that a rival merely relocates structure. The diagnostic shifts. Where §§4.1–4.2 test accounts that claim to avoid the structure, this cluster tests whether the account can answer genuine questions from within.
